reasoning_traces.think:
The Pythagorean formula arises from the probability that a team's Weibull-distributed runs scored exceed those allowed. Under independence, this probability integrates to the familiar power-law ratio. The optimal γ = 1.82 balances bias-variance tradeoff: smaller γ underfits low-variance eras (e.g., Dead Ball), larger γ overfits high-variance modern periods. Failure modes include non-integer scoring (discrete Poisson better) and time-correlated errors (ARCH/GARCH corrections needed).
